# Preserve selector focus across operation changes

D331224 at revision b484a481f7fbfc7d5c4befd12d215f3a32fbfb05 reports that setCalendarEventRoute() replaced a focused calendar selector and left focus on the document body. The review says the shared show method returns early for an already open dialog, so initial-opening focus logic alone cannot repair this case. When replacing the focused selector, restore focus to the current enabled selector or another suitable dialog target while retaining separate controls and operation numbers that reject delayed input from an old operation. Minimum test coverage: focus the old selector, replace the route, await readiness, assert focus on the current dialog target, and retain the stale-input assertion. The amendment reportedly passed 226 headless checks, including 51 accessibility checks, plus lint, syntax, and diff checks. These are claims in the review record without independent logs or a source diff; handled status does not establish landing or a general convention.

Scope: Calendar event route focus and stale input.
